name: codex-mcp
description: Riff Labs fork of cexll/codex-mcp-server, evolving toward fuller Codex automation over MCP with job control, thread workflows, and Codex execution tools.

working_directory.title: Working Directory
working_directory.description: Default project directory for Codex operations

tools.name: ask-codex
tools.description: Execute Codex with a prompt, optional file references, and model selection

tools.name: batch-codex
tools.description: Process multiple Codex requests in sequence

tools.name: brainstorm
tools.description: Ideation with SCAMPER and design-thinking frameworks

tools.name: ask-codex-command
tools.description: Single-call blocking Codex execution that waits for a final reply

tools.name: get-codex-job
tools.description: Retrieve status and incremental output for async ask-codex jobs with long-polling support

tools.name: fetch-chunk
tools.description: Retrieve paginated responses from change-mode operations

tools.name: list-codex-threads
tools.description: List active Codex thread bindings managed by the tmux backend

tools.name: timeout-test
tools.description: Run a timed operation to validate timeout prevention behavior
